rdfs:label: PeriodOfTime
rdfs:comment: A named or bounded interval of time — a year, an era, a meeting window, a coverage period.
notes: Use as the value type of `urn:solid:temporal` for richer time-coverage metadata than a plain ISO 8601 interval string. Give its bounds with `dcat:startDate` / `dcat:endDate` (DCAT 2+), or `time:hasBeginning` / `time:hasEnd`. For full temporal logic with intervals, instants, and Allen relations, use the OWL-Time vocabulary instead.

history.note: Example now uses dcat:startDate/endDate instead of AS2 startTime/endTime; seeAlso points to dcat and the OWL-Time Interval IRI.
